test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 2: USER ACCOUNT RECOVERY SCENARIO
test_cases.test_case_title: Access Password Reset Page via Recovery Link
test_cases.pre_condition: A user has previously initiated the password reset process, and a unique, time-sensitive password recovery link has been sent to their registered email address. The system is online and able to process authentication requests.
test_cases.expected_result: The secure password reset page is successfully accessed, allowing the user to create a new password. The system verifies the validity of the recovery link.
test_cases.post_condition: The user is on the secure password reset page, prompted to enter a new password.

test_steps.step: Access the recovery email in the user's inbox.
Click the unique, time-sensitive password recovery link provided in the email.
